raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be a friend of"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the user"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have"
      role subject ?x
      role object "more than 3 outstanding debts"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  except ?x "Sorin"
